summary.en: One line crosses a page at a constant speed; each block it passes is framed by corners collapsing onto it and named by a machine label typing itself out, while a status row counts the signals read.
summary.zh: 一条扫描线匀速掠过页面；扫过哪块，哪块就被一组角标收拢对准，再贴一枚逐字打出的机器标签，顶部状态行实时计数。

fits: Showing that the product reads something (a page, a document, a design): what it finds, block by block.
notFor: More than six findings (labels crowd); findings that need a sentence each (labels are a word and a detail).

overlaps.note: findings marked on a document; scan-read ties every finding to the moment the line passes it
the line alone; scan-read adds the corners, labels and counter
one target locked; scan-read locks six in turn with its corners

intent.en: The viewer watches the product read a page and name what it finds, so its understanding feels concrete and fast.
intent.zh: 看着产品读一页内容并逐块说出读到了什么，让它的“理解”具体又迅速。

content.en: A screenshot the window's size (or the neutral page) with 2–6 block rectangles; for each a label head ≤ 8 chars and detail ≤ 18 chars; status words ≤ 12 chars.
content.zh: 一张窗口大小的截图（或中性页面）和 2–6 个区块矩形；每块一个 ≤ 3 字的标签头和 ≤ 6 字的细节；状态词 ≤ 4 字。

fits.zh: 表现产品在“读”东西（网页、文档、设计稿）：逐块读出它找到了什么。

notFor.zh: 多于六条发现（标签会挤）；每条发现要一句话才说得清的（标签只有一个词加一个细节）。

pairs.note: the findings expanded one by one after the scan

en: Blocks fire when the line passes their foot: two blocks with the same foot fire 4 frames apart, so order them by height.
Labels sit outside their block (right, above, below): leave room on the page for them.
zh: 扫描线过区块下缘才触发：下缘同高的两块相隔 4 帧，按高度排好顺序。
标签贴在区块外侧（右、上、下）：页面上要给它留位置。

upstream.name: 扫描取景标注
upstream.summary: 一条扫描线自上而下匀速掠过已存在的页面，越过哪块区块的下缘，哪块就被四角取景框从外扩处弹簧收拢对准（一次过冲），随后贴出一枚逐字打出的机器标签，顶部状态行同步计数 00/06→06/06
upstream.use: "AI 正在读你的页面/品牌"的分析镜头；设计系统/品牌规范的拆解介绍；产品能力的自我说明段
upstream.energy: 中（机械冷静，节奏由扫描线匀速推动，标注是节拍点）
